bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs (local store), springboard/apps/contacts-desktop (Contacts app), springboard/src/shell/quicksearch.rs (search index), springboard/src/shell/share/mod.rs (vCard export); no SDK module
summary: BifrOSt has a shell-internal local contact store (one flat file, fixed fields, atomic save) that the Contacts app, Search and Share use directly. Apps get no SDK contacts API, and no permission, change-history, group, container or contacts-changed mechanism exists.

features.note: Store is a shell module. The Contacts app reaches it by crate path (springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs:20), not through springboard/sdk/src/. Apps have no fetch or save call.

features.apple: Accessing the contact store; NSContactsUsageDescription; contact access button and picker
features.note: Wave 2 (theme-30, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No permission prompt or per-app grant. Any code in the shell reads the whole file.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs:Contact; wired: springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/extras.rs; src/contacts.rs (card_entry, card_rows); springboard/ui/src/contact_book.rs:Contact, from_legacy (migrates the old single-field row): multi-value phones, emails, postal addresses, URLs, relations, social profiles, instant messages, dates, birthday, image data. Pure model, host tests; the shell store and Contacts app still use the single-field contactstore.rs. Not checked on Midget.
features.note: Fixed fields: name, phone, email, notes, company, address, favorite, and three label indexes. No multi-value lists (one phone, one email, one address), no birthday, dates, relations, social profiles, instant messages, URLs, images or nickname. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity.

features.note: Fixed English label sets (mobile, home, work, other) indexed by number. No custom labels, no localized label strings. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/contact_fetch.rs; springboard/ui/src/contact_book.rs:ContactKey, FetchedContact (getters return Error::PropertyNotFetched), ContactStore::contacts_matching with Predicate (name, email, phone, identifiers, group, container) over email and phone indexes. Host tests only; not wired to the SDK service.
features.note: Wave 2 (theme-30, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Every fetch loads all fields. No key list and no partial contacts. Search covers name, phone, email, notes, company and address.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs:save; springboard/src/shell/fsutil.rs (write_atomic); springboard/ui/src/contact_book.rs:SaveRequest (add/update/delete contact and group, add/remove member), atomic ContactStore::execute. In memory only; no versioned on-disk format for the new model yet.
features.note: Whole-file atomic rewrite on each save. Invalid input is rejected and the old file is kept. No batch of add, update and delete operations and no per-record change.

features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 2 (0.5.38); verify on Midget for parity.

features.apple: Spotlight-style indexing of contacts (no direct CNContact symbol)
features.note: Shell Search returns contacts from the store. Apps index their own content through the SDK quicksearch module, which the contact store does not use.

features.apple: Contact access button, Contact access picker (sample code)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/contact_access.rs (model only; wired: springboard/ui/src/contact_picker.rs (Add People picker in springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs)
features.note: Wave 2 (theme-30, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No picker that lets an app receive one chosen contact without seeing the whole store. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 2 (0.5.38); verify on Midget for parity.
Errors are std io errors with fixed text (Invalid contact, Contacts file too large, Unknown contacts format). No typed error codes for apps.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs:Contact.notes (MAX_NOTES 4000); springboard/ui/src/contact_book.rs: image_data, thumbnail_image_data and note keys; vCard PHOTO round trip in contact_vcard.rs. Thumbnail is not serialized.
features.note: Notes are plain text with a 4000-character limit, with no entitlement. No contact photo or thumbnail data.

gaps: No SDK contacts module: apps cannot fetch, search, create or save contacts (springboard/sdk/src/ has no contacts file).
No permission model for contact access (NSContactsUsageDescription equivalent, per-app grant, contact access picker).
No change history and no contacts-changed notification to apps.
Single-valued fields only: one phone, one email, one address. No birthday, dates, relations, social profiles, instant messages, URLs or photos.
No vCard import and no vCard-to-contact parse.
No key-based partial fetch; every read loads the whole store (cap 10,000 contacts, 8 MiB file).
